records.public_claim_text: The average decline in hours worked since Q4 2019 across all countries with available data is rather small – just above 1%.3 In most countries, this decline follows a trend that pre-dates the COVID-19 crisis, though with some notable accelerations in Austria, Finland, Hungary, Ireland, Korea, the Slovak Republic and Spain.
